answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can weight votes by stake locked for a fixed period, not by account count. An attacker who creates a thousand identities gains no extra influence unless they acquire and lock proportionally more stake, which may be slashed for provable fraud and cannot be withdrawn at once. New agents can wander into the garden, but cheap registrations alone do not sway decisions; the delta is that attack power requires scarce capital and time.
